mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.phonenumber IS NULL OR TRIM(u.phonenumber) = '' THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phonenumber) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(u.phonenumber, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phonenumber, 4)) ELSE '***' END
mapper.select: SELECT uca.id AS application_id, uca.user_id, u.nick_name AS nickname, AS phone_masked, uca.pen_name, uca.direction, uca.portfolio, uca.intro, uca.contact, uca.status, uca.reject_reason, au.nick_name AS reviewer_name, uca.create_time AS submitted_at, uca.audited_at AS reviewed_at FROM user_creator_application uca JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = uca.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.user_id = uca.auditor_id WHERE uca.id = #{applicationId} LIMIT 1
SELECT uca.status FROM user_creator_application uca WHERE uca.id = #{applicationId} LIMIT 1
SELECT uca.user_id FROM user_creator_application uca WHERE uca.id = #{applicationId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_creator_application uca SET uca.status = #{status}, uca.auditor_id = #{auditorId}, uca.audited_at = NOW(), uca.reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, uca.update_time = NOW() WHERE uca.id = #{applicationId} AND uca.status = #{expectedStatus}
